title: Project Titan: Sprint 42 Architecture & DB Migration
executive_summary: Sprint 42 kickoff focusing on database migration to PostgreSQL, backend API rate-limiting resolution led by David, and UI component revamp led by Elena.
transcript:
[00:00] Sarah: Team, let's kick off Sprint 42. Our main goal is the PostgreSQL migration and finalizing the dashboard designs.
[00:15] David: On the backend side, I will complete the database schema migration and fix the 429 rate limit issue by Wednesday.
[00:32] Elena: The UI system is 80% done. I will deliver the responsive mobile components and user settings screens by Thursday.
[00:48] Sarah: Awesome. David, make sure automated tests pass before staging deploy. Elena, sync with Rahul on the frontend integration.
[01:05] David: Understood. I'll also add Redis caching for session tokens.
[01:18] Sarah: Perfect. Let's aim for staging verification by Friday afternoon.
key_points: David leading PostgreSQL schema migration and 429 rate limit fixes by Wednesday.
Elena delivering responsive mobile components and user settings by Thursday.
Elena to sync directly with Rahul on frontend integration.
David adding Redis token caching to prevent session latency.
Target staging release scheduled for Friday afternoon.

action_items.task: Complete PostgreSQL schema migration and fix 429 rate limit issue
Deliver responsive mobile components and user settings screens
Coordinate with Rahul on frontend component contract
Add Redis token caching layer before staging deploy
Run end-to-end regression tests on staging environment

title: Acme Corp: Q4 Roadmap & Deliverables Sync
executive_summary: Quarterly review with Acme Corp stakeholders. Confirmed dark-mode dashboard preference, weekly Loom video recaps requirement, and November 15 release milestone.
transcript:
[00:00] Account Lead: Welcome everyone. Acme Corp stakeholders requested an update on our Q4 deliverables.
[00:14] Client Rep (Tom): We love the prototype. Just remember our CEO strictly insists on dark mode and wants 3-minute Loom video recaps before 4 PM every Friday.
[00:35] Sarah: Noted. We will keep the default theme dark and establish the Friday Loom routine.
[00:50] Client Rep (Tom): Excellent. Our executive sign-off meeting is set for November 12th ahead of the November 15th launch.
key_points: Acme Corp CEO strictly prefers dark mode interfaces as default.
Mandatory 3-minute weekly Loom video recaps due before Friday 4 PM EST.
Executive sign-off deadline scheduled for November 12th.
Target production launch date confirmed for November 15th.

action_items.task: Enforce dark mode default theme for Acme Corp client build
Set calendar reminder for weekly Friday 3 PM Loom video recording
Prepare release notes for November 12th executive sign-off
